Metta World Peace

Metta World Peace

(Formerly known as Ronald William Artest. Changed to Metta World Peace (2011) then to The Panda's Friend (~2014) and Metta Saniford-Artest (2020).)

Position: Small Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-7, 260lb (201cm, 117kg)

Born: November 13, 1979 in Queensbridge, New York us

College: St. John's

High School: La Salle Academy in New York, New York

Draft: Chicago Bulls, 1st round (16th pick, 16th overall), 1999 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 3, 1999

Career Length: 17 years

  • 1x All Star
  • 2010 NBA Champ
  • 2003-04 All-NBA
  • 1999-00 All-Rookie
  • 4x All-Defensive
  • 2003-04 Def. POY

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Metta World Peace?

Metta World Peace is 46 years old.

Where was Metta World Peace born?

Metta World Peace was born in Queensbridge, New York.

When was Metta World Peace born?

Metta World Peace was born on November 13, 1979.

How tall is Metta World Peace?

Metta World Peace is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much did Metta World Peace weigh when playing?

Metta World Peace weighed 260 lbs (117 kg) when playing.

Is Metta World Peace in the Hall of Fame?

Metta World Peace is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Metta World Peace drafted?

Metta World Peace was drafted by Chicago Bulls, 1st round (16th pick, 16th overall), 1999 NBA Draft.

What position did Metta World Peace play?

Small Forward.

When did Metta World Peace retire?

Metta World Peace last played in 2017.

What is Metta World Peace's net worth?

Metta World Peace made at least $77,053,906 playing professional basketball.

How much did Metta World Peace make?

Metta World Peace made $7,526,316 in 2007.

What did Metta World Peace average?

Metta World Peace averaged 13.2 points, 4.5 rebounds, and 2.7 assists per game.

How many rings does Metta World Peace have?

Metta World Peace won one championship.

What schools did Metta World Peace attend?

Metta World Peace attended La Salle Academy in New York, New York and St. John's.
